Team —

Quick follow from today’s xfn sync. Two items blocking our QBR narrative and the Aurelia Health pilot run that we need owners on by EOW:

1) Performance acceptance window for the pilot (Aurelia): Lauren to confirm a dedicated 2-hour load window and who owns the test harness. We need green evidence for the execs.
2) Compliance artifacts for procurement (SOC2 gap): Marissa to surface the minimal artifact set procurement accepts for signature (not full report).

Additional asks for the exec-ready checklist:
- A one-slide summary (metrics + ask) for each blocker
- A short risk sentence and proposed mitigation per item
- ETA on any outstanding roll-forward decisions (model pin, quantization profile)

I’ve attached a working deck (QBR_promo_deck_draft_v2.pptx) and left a commented section in the Drive folder for slide owners: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBqQBR-Prep-Redwood

Please reply with: owner / 1-line status / expected ship date. I’ll collate and escalate any exec asks on Friday morning.

— Karthik

Thanks everyone — good progress. Finalizing exec asks for Friday AM: below are the items I will present and owners for escalation if we miss EOD deadlines. Please treat these as final unless you call out changes by EOD Friday.

EXEC ASKS (to present to SVP):
- Pilot scale evidence (owner: Lauren) — deliverable: test run report + one-slide summary (metrics: p95/p99, error rate). Due: 2028-03-21 10:00 PT
- Procurement acceptance pack (owner: Marissa) — deliverable: SOC2 extracts + retention statement + signed procurement note. Due: 2028-03-14 EOD (Marissa flagged legal review pending)
- Runtime config decision (owner: Vivek) — deliverable: final runtime profile and quantization pin for pilot. Due: 2028-03-18 EOD

If any of these slip, I will request a short exec mitigation plan (one sentence + owner + new date). I’ll also open INF-7421 for any remaining open action items and attach the final artifacts to the Drive folder and HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks again — I’ll circulate my slide pack and the SVP note Friday morning.
